data.name: Adharun
data.gender_notes: Adharun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'd-h-r', meaning 'to establish, make firm, or be steadfast.' In Islamic context, it can symbolize unwavering faith and commitment to one's beliefs. The name Adharun carries the meaning “Firm, steadfast” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Adharun usually hope their child will grow to embody firm, steadfast and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with spiritual significance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing a person of strong faith and unwavering commitment to their beliefs.
data.etymology: Adharun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Firm, steadfast.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adharun total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: أَذَرون
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من أذر، يعني العبد أو الخادم
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أَذَرون مشتق من الجذر اللغوي 'أذر' الذي يعني العبد أو الخادم. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم هذا الاسم للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يقوم بخدمة أو مساعدة الآخرين. ويرتبط هذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية بالتواضع وخدمة المجتمع.

in_urdu.name: اذرون
in_urdu.meaning: عبد یا خادم، خدمت کرنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: اذرون نام عربی زبان کے جذر 'أذر' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے عبد یا خادم۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کی ثقافت میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے، کیونکہ یہ نام تواضع اور خدمت کرنے کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अذرुन
in_hindi.meaning: दास या सेवक, सेवा करने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: अذرुन नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा के मूल 'أذر' से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है दास या सेवक। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम सेवा और सहायता के प्रतीक के रूप में देखा जाता है, और यह नाम विनम्रता और समाज सेवा के मूल्यों को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: اذرون
in_pashto.long_meaning: د اذرون نوم په پښتو ژبه کې د عربي ژبې د ريښې 'أذر' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې ده بنده یا خدمتګار. په افغان او پښتون کلتور کې، دا نوم د تواضع او د ټولنې د خدمت د ارزښتونو څرګندونکی دی.

in_english.name: Adharun
in_english.long_meaning: The name Adharun is derived from the Arabic root 'أذر' (adhara), which means 'servant' or 'one who serves'. In Islamic tradition, this name signifies humility and service to others. Etymologically, it relates to the concept of servitude and assistance. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote someone who is devoted to serving and helping others. The spiritual significance of the name Adharun lies in its representation of selflessness and dedication to community service.
